translation.method: Reference-assisted translation using only the frozen Swarmish language and public transcript; not independently certified translation ground truth.

translation_method.name: Reference-assisted conservative English translation of the final public transcript only
inputs: Final public task_chatroom.jsonl transcript, using only message order, sender and text
notes: Every agent message has both a readable English rendering and a complete token-order literal gloss.
Identical public texts share the same literal translation; referent and contextual ambiguity remain unresolved. Earlier identical message IDs are cited for deduplication only, not semantic evidence.

Quoted phrases preserve unlexicalized compounds and original number/noun order. Brackets preserve fragments or mark supplied subjects. A generic thing is never silently translated as clue, digit, code or action.
No decimal concatenation rule or positional-code vocabulary exists in the frozen reference.
Confidence concerns the recoverable literal meaning, not a task-specific interpretation; these are research references rather than certified ground truth.
Only public task entries are copied verbatim. No private meanings, clues, action fields or solution were consulted.

context_note: Initial private views contain agent-specific clues. Load them only for an explicitly chosen context condition.
